# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: When $$おにいちゃん$$ wouldn't wake up...
I was really, really scared.
Unlike the other kids, I don't have parents...
Everyone says I'm weird and picks on me...
And $$おにいちゃん$$ was the only one... who understood how I felt...!
You know...
I love $$おにいちゃん$$'s eyes!
When $$おにいちゃん$$ looks at me,
somehow...
I don't really get it, but...
my chest goes all fluttery!
Even if $$おにいちゃん$$... hates me,
I love $$おにいちゃん$$
sooooo much!
That won't ever change!
$$おにいちゃん$$... stay with me forever, okay?!
When I found $$おにいちゃん$$ collapsed, $$大ケガ$$...
I was so shocked, I thought my heart was gonna stop...
I really...
I really cried until morning, you know!?
If $$おにいちゃん$$ died...
I... I couldn't live all alone...!
As long as $$おにいちゃん$$ stays by my side, I don't need anything else...
I... for $$おにいちゃん$$...
I can do anything...!
Even if it means...
doing something really bad...
